subject: SAME AS clause
notes: SR1 "Data-name-1 shall not be subject to any OCCURS clauses." (--check 13.18.49.3 -> OK 1)). ExpandSameAs walks target.Parent upward and rejects any IsTable ancestor with COBOL1556 (every level, not just the parent). The SameAsTests case (10 F under 05 ROW-E OCCURS 3) is spec-derived. The target's OWN OCCURS is SR5's separate arm. || Editions (adjudicator's statement, normalized to 2002,2014,2023 by registrar 14e): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the SAME AS clause is absent from COBOL-85 and is not in Annex E's 2014->2023 substantive-changes list, so the rule stands unchanged in 2014 and 2023)
